page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c8i.48xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 192 dedicated physical cores using the Intel Xeon 8475B processor running at a clock speed of 2.7 GHz. With a 1.0 thread-per-core configuration, each of the 192 vCPUs maps directly to a dedicated physical core, eliminating resource contention from hyperthreading.

The instance is equipped with 512.0 GB of system memory, yielding a resource density of 2.67 GB of RAM per core. It does not include local storage or integrated GPU hardware, requiring external network-attached storage for data persistence. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 100 Gbps, facilitating high-throughput data transfers.

From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the dedicated core allocation and high-density compute configuration make this instance suitable for CPU-bound workloads that require predictable performance without hyperthreading overhead. Appropriate workloads include high-performance computing, intensive batch processing, large-scale scientific simulations, and compute-heavy enterprise applications.
